briefs.episode_title: Don't Chase This Rally | Lance Roberts
briefs.one_line_summary: Investors should await a market pullback to add exposure, rather than chasing the current rally.
core_claims: Forward returns remain strong with a 100% win rate over 12-24 months when markets rally back above the 200-day moving average in under four weeks.
Pullbacks will occur, offering opportunities to buy into the market around recent all-time high breakouts or the 50-day moving average.
A 5-10% market correction is expected heading into the midterm elections.
briefs.positioning_implication: Reduce immediate buying pressure; de-emphasize chasing current market momentum in favor of accumulating positions during anticipated pullbacks.

clusters.name: Rally: Stalling.
clusters.description: The narrative suggests the current market rally is losing momentum, advising investors to wait for a pullback.
